_about: Canonical desired protection for main. BurnBar CI Gate evaluates trusted-base policy, while independently required security contexts remain immutable even if candidate code tampers with the umbrella workflow. Conversation resolution, reviews, no force pushes, no deletion, and exact-current-base checks remain hard gates.
_derivation: Hardened on 2026-07-24 after validating that candidate-controlled evaluator code and a zero-review policy could bypass component checks. Expensive product suites may report skipped only when the deterministic classifier proves their paths are unaffected.

_pending_required_status_checks._comment: Component contexts are enforced by governance/burnbar-ci-gate.json, not classic branch protection. These remain informational or path-scoped.
